text:
Fixed. The issue was in `page_count` in `pager/paginate.py`: it used `total_items // per_page + 1`, which always adds an extra page when the item count is an exact multiple of `per_page` (e.g., 9 items at 3/page → 4 pages instead of 3). I replaced it with ceiling division `max(1, (total_items + per_page - 1) // per_page)`, which preserves the documented behavior of returning at least 1 page for an empty collection.

Verified:
- `paginate(range(9), 3, 3)` now reports `total_pages=3`, `has_next=False`
- Requesting page 4 raises `ValueError` instead of returning an empty list
- 10 items at 3/page still gives 4 pages; empty collection still gives 1 page
- Existing test suite passes
